description: A Digilent Basys 3 FPGA board with an Artix-7 XC7A35T chip, 16 switches, 5 buttons, 16 LEDs, a four-digit seven-segment display and three Pmod ports.
summary: The board runs the user's Verilog in the iynk cycle simulator. Ports stand in for pins: switches, buttons, LEDs, the seven-segment display and the Pmod outputs. It does not synthesise a design or time it.
clock: Clock input: 100 MHz on the board.
activelow: Active low: 0 means pressed or lit.

models.1: Verilog subset run by the cycle simulator with the Basys 3 ports, one pin per port bit.
models.2: Switches, buttons (active high), LEDs, the seven-segment display (common anode, active low) and the Pmod ports JA, JB and JC as outputs.
models.3: A design that declares CLK_HZ runs at 100 kHz instead of the 100 MHz board clock.

not.1: Synthesis, timing closure and constraint files.
not.2: The XADC analog inputs, VGA, PS/2, USB and the UART.
not.3: Block RAM sizing and the electrical limits of the pins.

gap: No electrical ratings are listed yet, so no pin-overload check exists for this board.
